end.summary: Discussed that energy makes things move, work, heat up, light up, and make sound.
end.parentNote: Prisha practised identifying effects of energy and matching sources such as food, sunlight, wind, flowing water, fuels, and electricity to what they make work. They connected wind with a kite and sunlight with a solar-powered pump, and noticed that a TV can produce heat, light, and sound. They mixed up whether a TV shows movement as an effect of energy; this was discussed but not fully corrected by the end. At home, ask Prisha to name one energy source and one effect while looking at everyday objects.
